title: SEO Content Writer (Intern)
description:

Responsibilities

* Produce **4 to 5 well-researched tech articles, explainers, how-tos, or news pieces per week**.

* Strong written English with good grammar and editing skills.
* Ability to write quickly without compromising accuracy.

Students, recent graduates, and freshers with strong English writing skills are encouraged to apply. **Apply for the Tech Content Writer Intern role:**

title: Copywriter
description:
MoSPI (Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation) typically focuses on official data releases, statistical reports, public awareness campaigns, and digital outreach rather than commercial product advertising. A specialized Job Description (JD) for a **Copywriter / Content Writer** tailored for MoSPI can be structured as follows:Job Title**Copywriter / Content & Communications Specialist (MoSPI)**Job OverviewThe Copywriter will craft clear, engaging, and accessible content to translate complex statistical data, economic indicators, and governmental programs into public-friendly insights. The role bridges the gap between technical data producers (statisticians, analysts) and general citizens, policy-makers, media, and digital audiences.Key Responsibilities

* **Translate Data into Narratives:** Transform complex statistical reports (e.g., GDP releases, CPI/IIP data, NSSO surveys) into clear summaries, press releases, info-cards, and web articles.
* **Digital & Social Media Content:** Write crisp, engaging copy for MoSPI’s official social media handles (X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube scripts) to promote statistical literacy and awareness. [1, 2]

Required Qualifications & Education

* **Degree:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Public Relations, or Economics/Statistics with a strong flair for writing.

* **Language Proficiency:** Fluency in **English** and **Hindi** (both written and verbal) to handle bilingual national communications. [1, 2]

Required Skills

* **Simplification Skills:** Ability to turn dry numbers and technical jargon into compelling, easy-to-understand public stories.

* **Design Familiarity:** Basic understanding of design tools like Canva or Adobe suite to coordinate visual layouts with copy.

description:

**Company Name:** Orbitouch Outsourcing Private Limited  
**Location:** Tilak Nagar, New Delhi  
**Position:** SEO & Content Writer  
**Experience:** 1.5–3 Years  
**CTC:** Up to ₹4 LPA (depending on experience and interview)  
**Working Days:** 6 Days a Week

About the Company

Orbitouch Outsourcing Private Limited provides recruitment and outsourcing solutions to businesses. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented SEO & Content Writer who can improve our online visibility, create engaging content, and drive organic traffic through effective SEO strategies.

Job Overview

The candidate will be responsible for developing SEO-friendly content, optimizing website pages, conducting keyword research, and implementing content strategies to improve search engine rankings, website traffic, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. SEO Management**

* Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis to identify ranking opportunities.
* Optimize website pages, meta titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal links.
* Implement on-page and off-page SEO strategies.
* Monitor keyword rankings, organic traffic, and website performance.
* Identify technical SEO issues and coordinate with the development team for resolution.
* Build quality backlinks and improve domain authority.

**2. Content Writing**

* Write SEO-friendly blogs, articles, website content, landing pages, and service descriptions.

* Proofread and edit content to ensure accuracy, readability, originality, and grammatical correctness.
* Update existing content to improve SEO performance and engagement.
* Use AI writing tools effectively while ensuring content quality, originality, and a natural tone.

**3. Performance Tracking & Reporting**

* Track website traffic, keyword rankings, impressions, clicks, and conversions.
* Use Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, and SEO tools to measure performance.
* Prepare regular SEO and content performance reports.
* Stay updated on Google algorithm changes, SEO trends, and content marketing best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; a degree or certification in Digital Marketing, English, Journalism, or a related field is preferred.
* 1.5–3 years of hands-on experience in SEO and content writing.
* Strong knowledge of on-page SEO, off-page SEO, keyword research, and content optimization.
* Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
* Familiarity with tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Ubersuggest, or similar SEO platforms.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Improvement in organic website traffic and keyword rankings.
* Quality and consistency of published content.
* Growth in website impressions, clicks, and organic leads.
* Improvement in existing page performance and content engagement.
* Timely completion of SEO activities and content deliverables.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with links or samples of their published content and SEO projects on mail or whatsapp.

title: Head of Design
description:
Candidates with a minimum of 10\+ years of dedicated experience in Commercial Office Interior Architecture \& Design only eligible.


**Role Definition**


The Head of Design holds total executive accountability for the creative vision, technical accuracy, commercial viability, and execution readiness of every design project at Divine Innovation. Directing a full multidisciplinary studio—including interior architects, 3D visualizers, furniture designers, proposal writers, and BOQ estimators—this leader translates sales downloads into awe\-inspiring, budget\-aligned workspace environments. The Head of Design personally checks all drawing packages to ensure 100% zero\-ambiguity handovers to project execution and purchase teams, while co\-leading design pitches to leave enterprise clients flabbergasted.

**Responsibilities \& Deliverables**

* **Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching:** Lead the design studio in crafting innovative commercial office concepts, while personally joining the Sales team to present and defend high\-ticket enterprise design pitches.
* **Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff:** Rigorously check and vet 100% of technical drawings (GFCs, MEP, civil, ceiling, layout) to ensure project execution teams receive flawless packages requiring zero back\-and\-forth clarification.
* **Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance:** Direct the in\-house BOQ and proposal team to ensure all creative concepts strictly adhere to targeted client budgets and Divine Innovation’s gross margin requirements.
* **Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership:** Oversee the internal furniture design team to produce precise, production\-ready factory shop drawings for custom joinery and workstations manufactured at the IMT Manesar plant.

**Tasks and Activities**

**1\. Creative Direction \& Enterprise Client Pitching**

* Take comprehensive project downloads from the Sales team, converting client headcount, aesthetic, and functional requirements into world\-class design solutions.
* Direct and mentor the studio team (interior designers, 3D renderers, space planners) to deliver designs that exceed client expectations ("happily flabbergast" the client).
* Partner with Sales Managers on key enterprise accounts to lead design presentations, walk CXOs through 3D models, and articulate design rationale.
* Enforce strict adherence to Divine Innovation's Process System Structure (PSS) for design SLA turnaround times from sales download to proposal delivery.

**2\. Airtight Technical Documentation \& Execution Handoff**

* Personally review, mark up, and approve 100% of drawing packages generated by the studio prior to client sign\-off and site release.
* Deliver complete, hyper\-detailed Good for Construction (GFC) drawing dockets to the Head of Projects, eliminating any need for execution teams to seek mid\-project clarifications.
* Write crystal\-clear material specifications, bill\-of\-materials (BOM), and procurement notes so non\-technical Purchase team members can source exact items effortlessly.

**3\. Design\-to\-Budget \& BOQ Governance**

* Supervise proposal and BOQ estimators to build detailed cost breakdowns alongside design development.
* Enforce "Design\-to\-Budget" principles: either design strictly within an established client budget or establish a baseline BOQ that protects target gross margins.
* Review all pre\-bid BOQs and techno\-commercial proposals for line\-item accuracy, material specification alignment, and commercial safety before client submission.

**4\. Factory Integration \& Furniture Design Leadership**

* Lead the dedicated Furniture Design team in developing custom modular workstations, executive desks, and loose furniture concepts.
* Ensure creation of millimeter\-accurate factory shop drawings (joinery details, hardware specs, finish schedules) for seamless production at the IMT Manesar manufacturing plant.
* Coordinate with the IMT Manesar production team to verify prototype feasibility, material availability, and manufacturing standards.

**Measurement Metrics**

* **Zero\-Query Handoff Rate:** 100% zero\-query technical handovers (Project execution team proceeds without requiring drawing clarifications).
* **Design SLA Adherence:** 100% compliance with internal PSS turnaround timelines from sales download to initial proposal presentation.
* **Design\-to\-Budget Accuracy:** 100% budget compliance with zero margin degradation caused by design oversights or unbudgeted material specs.
* **Enterprise Pitch Win Rate:** Contribution to achieving a 30%\+ win rate on key enterprise pitch presentations.
* **Non\-Technical Purchase Execution:** 0 purchasing errors resulting from vague or incomplete design specifications.

**Competencies We Are Looking For**

**Skills**

* Creative Design Leadership \& Commercial Workspace Concept Design
* High\-Impact Enterprise Client Pitching \& CXO Presentation
* Rigorous Technical Drawing Verification \& Detail Auditing (CAD/Revit/BIM)
* Design\-to\-Budget Engineering \& BOQ Estimation Governance
* Factory Shop Drawing Review (Modular Joinery \& Furniture Manufacturing)
* Cross\-Functional Specification Writing for Procurement Teams

**Knowledge**

* Deep expertise in commercial workplace architecture, space planning ratios, and ergonomics
* Thorough understanding of civil, MEP, HVAC, acoustic, lighting, and fire safety systems
* Material costs, finishing techniques, and commercial fit\-out procurement workflows
* Industrial furniture manufacturing processes, wood/metal joinery, and production workflows (IMT Manesar setup)

**Self\-Image**

* Master Design \& Technical Authority
* Creative Visionary with Commercial Discipline
* Flawless Execution Enabler

**Traits**

* Obsessive attention to technical detail and drawing accuracy
* High aesthetic sensibility combined with practical buildability
* Articulate, charismatic communicator with executive presence
* Calm under tight SLA pressure and multi\-project demands

**Motives**

* Driven by creating iconic, award\-worthy corporate workspace environments
* Motivated by technical perfection and zero\-error project execution
* Committed to building a seamless bridge between design creativity, manufacturing, and site delivery

**About TransCurators**

TransCurators is a leading content solutions company delivering high\-quality Content,

Editorial, Localization, Translation, Publishing, Digital Content, E\-learning, Creative

Services, and Video Production solutions to global enterprises, startups, and EdTech

organizations. We create engaging visual content for brands across corporate communication,

digital marketing, social media, learning solutions, and advertising.

As our creative services continue to grow, we are looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented

Video Editor who can transform raw footage into compelling visual stories while

maintaining the highest standards of creativity, technical excellence, and brand consistency.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly creative, technically proficient, and execution\-focused Video

Editor to manage end\-to\-end post\-production for a wide variety of video projects.

The Video Editor will be responsible for assembling raw footage into polished, engaging, and visually compelling content by combining storytelling, editing techniques, sound design, motion graphics, colour grading, and visual effects. The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of narrative flow, pacing, audience engagement, and platform\-specific content optimization.

This role requires close collaboration with Video Producers, Motion Graphic Designers, Creative Teams, Account Managers, and Clients to ensure every video meets creative expectations, business objectives, and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Video Editing \& Storytelling**

 Edit raw footage into compelling and engaging videos while maintaining the intended

narrative and creative vision.

 Understand project objectives, target audience, brand guidelines, and client

expectations before editing.

 Structure content to maximize viewer engagement and storytelling effectiveness.

 Create edits for:

o Corporate Films

o Brand Videos

o Social Media Content

o Advertisements

o Product Videos

o Explainer Videos

o Training \& E\-learning Videos

o Event Videos

o Interviews

o Testimonials

o Promotional Videos

o Podcasts \& Webinars

o Reels, Shorts \& YouTube Videos

o AI Videos

o Rough Cut

o Fine Cut

o Final Cut

o Colour Correction

o Colour Grading

o Audio Cleanup

o Sound Mixing

o Background Music Integration

o Noise Reduction

o Subtitle Integration

o Captioning

o Video Compression

o Export Optimization

visual effects.

 Create engaging intros, outros, title animations, and call\-to\-action sequences.

 Collaborate with Motion Graphic Designers for advanced animation requirements.

 Ensure visual consistency throughout the video.

**4\. Audio Editing \& Enhancement**

 Clean and enhance audio quality.

 Synchronize voiceovers with visuals.

 Balance dialogue, background music, and sound effects.

 Remove unwanted background noise.

 Ensure professional audio quality across all deliverables.

**5\. Colour Grading \& Visual Quality**

 Perform colour correction and cinematic colour grading.

 Match colour profiles across multiple camera sources.

 Ensure visual consistency across shots.

 Improve lighting and exposure where required.

 Deliver visually appealing content aligned with brand identity.

**6\. Collaboration \& Creative Execution**

 Work closely with:

o Video Producers

o Creative Team

o Motion Graphic Designers

o Account Managers

o Clients

o Production Team

 Understand creative briefs before beginning edits.

 Participate in creative discussions and brainstorming sessions.
